build_MapBuilder: build a MapBuilder instance from a params dict with frame dimensions, fov, vision range, map size, resolution, z bins, and agent settings
update_map_MapBuilder: update the occupancy map by passing a depth image and current agent pose, returning cropped view, ground truth map, and explored regions
get_st_pose_MapBuilder: get the normalized spatial transformer pose from a current location tuple by converting world coordinates to normalized map coordinates
reset_map_MapBuilder: reset the internal occupancy map to zeros with a new map size in centimeters
get_map_MapBuilder: get the current internal occupancy map as a numpy array with shape based on map size, resolution, and z bins
